message.reasoning_content: Round 2 action. I have 17M cash. Options: donkey (1 alashi → 1 good), shuttle, produce. I'm president already; production gives 2 goods. Produce is free goods. Cash 17M... donkey costs 1, gives 1 good — goods sell at declining prices; sold_counter=6, price for next ~3-4. After round 2 boundary, cash devalues floor(cash/100)*62 → 62%! So holding cash into boundary is bad. But donkey spends cash into goods — good. Produce gives 2 free goods. Can only do one action. Donkey gives 1 good for 1 (price ~3-4), roughly break-even. Shuttle gives 3 goods with 25% confiscation risk — expected 2.25 goods, better than produce's 2. Prices next market around 3-4 alashi/unit. Shuttle EV ≈ 2.25 units × ~3 = 6.75 vs produce 2×3=6. Marginal. Shuttle slightly better but risk; tariff none. I'll take shuttle for higher EV.
